title_original: The Film Comment Podcast: Fall 2026 New Releases
excerpt_original: Inney Prakash and Michael Blair join to debate You Can See Everything , Digger , and Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother

blocks.text: On this week’s episode, Film Comment Editors Devika Girish and Clinton Krute invited FC Contributing Editor Inney Prakash and Assistant Editor Michael Blair to debate three new films that are currently gracing the marquees of multiplexes and stirring up discourse: Bassam Tariq’s Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother (2:30); Alejandro González Iñárritu’s Digger (16:35); and Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s You Can See Everything (27:12).
